description: This is a low-polygon 3D model of an open treasure chest. The chest is dark gray and has a hinged lid, which is slightly ajar. Inside, the chest is filled with a shimmering yellow substance, possibly gold coins or sand, arranged in wavy patterns. At the back of the chest, there are three white, pillow-like objects that could represent valuable items or cushions for the treasure. The overall aesthetic is simple and stylized, characteristic of low-poly game assets.
